sourceEvidence.title: Quality Assurance Manager
sourceEvidence.quote:
* An undergraduate degree in an engineering or manufacturing related field is required.
* Minimum of 5 years experience supervising Quality Engineers and Quality Assurance personnel.
* Related experience in the electronics industry, both military and commercial aviation products with detailed knowledge of industry processes and practices.
* Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) quality practices, including an understanding of Manufacturing Inspection District Office (MIDO) approved facilities and Parts Manufacturer Approval (PMA) procedures.
* Experience in AS9100, AS9145, and AS9102.
* Experienced in the use of Quality tools such as PPAP, CP, PFC, 8D, Ishikawa,
* Problem solving and analytical skills in making recommendations and decisions.
* Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma certification a plus.
